# See the mathematics. Run the idea.

Short, executable lessons that connect mathematical notation to working code—one concept and one experiment at a time.

[Browse all lessons](lessons/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
[Browse the source](https://github.com/EulerLettersAI/math-to-code){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-lg}

## How each lesson works

::: {.lesson-grid}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 1. Read

Build intuition from equations, diagrams, and carefully defined notation.
:::

::: {.lesson-card}
### 2. Run

Execute the code cell immediately after the mathematical concept.
:::

::: {.lesson-card}
### 3. Change

Download the source, vary its assumptions, and investigate what happens.
:::
:::

## A multidisciplinary collection

Euler Letters AI is multidisciplinary, so this collection comprises independent
lessons on miscellaneous topics rather than following a single curriculum. Each
lesson connects its mathematical formulation directly to executable code.
